chaos.title: Chaos controls
chaos.note: Make the server misbehave on purpose to watch how the page recovers. It affects every client connected to it.
chaos.needsConnection: The controls work while the connection is live.
chaos.pause.label: Pause the feed
chaos.pause.help: Stops all updates, so prices go stale. After Resume the feed continues with no gap.
chaos.resume.label: Resume the feed
chaos.gap.label: Lose a frame
chaos.gap.help: Skips one update, so the page sees a gap and asks for a fresh snapshot.
chaos.drop.label: Drop the connection
chaos.drop.help: Closes the connection like a network failure. The page reconnects by itself.
chaos.burst.label: Send a burst
chaos.burst.help: Five times the normal updates for that many seconds (1 to 60).
chaos.latency.label: Add latency
chaos.latency.help: Delays every update by that long (0 to 5,000). 0 removes it.
chaos.reset.label: Reset all faults
